description: This file defines the AccountPickerDialogFragment class, a dialog fragment used in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes to allow users to select an account, excluding the current account, for actions like moving notes between accounts.

classes.name: AccountPickerDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that displays a list of accounts for the user to pick from, excluding the current account.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to a context and initializes the account picker listener and target accounts list, filtering out the current account.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the dialog UI, displaying the list of accounts or a message if no other accounts are available.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets the soft input mode for the dialog window.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of the fragment with specified target accounts and current account ID.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles; no implementation needed here.
